title: C3: TaskDuplicateReconciler merge deletes the loser's whole subtree

description: ctx.delete(loser) cascades children/journal entries/attachments with no re-pointing or field merge (TaskDuplicateReconciler.swift:134-137). Failure scenario: an issue-#66-shaped duplicate-ID collision (the class that motivated the original reconciler) can lose an entire subtree of subtasks, notes, and attachments attached to whichever row loses the merge. Severity: Critical. Wave/Plan: Wave 1, plan 1a trash-tree-integrity. Sweep: stores/persistence.
